name: Hardware: 30B model on a 48 GB Mac vs a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU
why: The answer has to size each quantization against 24 GB of VRAM and the Mac's GPU-usable memory, explain that speed follows memory bandwidth (NVIDIA ~1 TB/s vs 273-307 GB/s on M4/M5 Pro), price a used 3090 build against a 48 GB Mac, and note that 30B mixture-of-experts models change the trade-off.
question: Best way to run a 30B-parameter model locally: 48 GB Mac or a PC with a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU? Speed, cost, quantization.
